decisions.reason: The award-winning plain yogurt builds directly on the firm's existing yogurt knowledge, so the firm can easily assimilate its success and improve it further.
The flagship organic cheese with onion and pepper leverages established cheese expertise and has strong strategic visibility, making withdrawal unlikely.

The semi-hard cheese wheel is close to the firm's established cheese production, but with limited promotional evidence the firm can still learn from it, leading to a low but slightly higher withdrawal probability.
The mild creamy soft cheese fits existing dairy capabilities and had a positive launch communication, so the firm can interpret and build on early results effectively.
